title: Ekadashi Shradh — Why the 11th Tithi is Auspicious for Pind Daan and Ancestor Rites
metaDescription: Complete guide to Ekadashi (11th lunar day) Shradh — its spiritual significance for ancestral rites, which Ekadashis are most powerful for Pind Daan, and the 2026 Ekadashi calendar.
author: Acharya Pandit V. K. Gayawal
summary: Ekadashi (the 11th lunar day) holds special significance for ancestors who died on this tithi. The Indira Ekadashi during Pitru Paksha is considered especially powerful for liberating ancestors. This guide covers all relevant Ekadashis for 2026.
content:
Ekadashi (एकादशी) — the 11th lunar day of both the waxing and waning moon — is associated with Lord Vishnu and holds special power for ancestral liberation ceremonies.

### Ekadashi and Pind Daan: The Connection
According to the Padma Purana, ancestors who died on an Ekadashi tithi or who were devoted to Lord Vishnu in life receive special benefit when Pind Daan is performed on Ekadashi at Gaya. The Vishnu Sahasranama states that Ekadashi is Lord Vishnu's day of special receptivity to prayers.

### Most Important Ekadashis for Ancestral Rites

**Indira Ekadashi** (during Pitru Paksha — September 2026)
This is THE most important Ekadashi for ancestral liberation. The Padma Purana dedicates an entire chapter to Indira Ekadashi: 'By observing Indira Ekadashi and performing Pind Daan at Gaya, one liberates an ancestor even from the deepest regions of Naraka.'

**Aja Ekadashi** (Bhadrapada Krishna Paksha — just before Pitru Paksha)
Particularly effective for those whose ancestors had unresolved karmic debts.

**Vaikuntha Ekadashi** (December-January)
Considered the gates of Vaikuntha (Vishnu's realm) are open — any ancestor-related prayer has maximum efficacy.

### 2026 Key Ekadashi Dates
- **Indira Ekadashi**: September 11, 2026 (during Pitru Paksha — book Gaya this day)
- **Vaikuntha Ekadashi**: December 27, 2026
- **Aja Ekadashi**: August 28, 2026

faqs.question: Should I perform Pind Daan on the ancestor's death Ekadashi?
faqs.answer: If your ancestor died on an Ekadashi tithi, performing Pind Daan on the same Ekadashi of the Hindu calendar year — especially Indira Ekadashi at Gaya — is considered especially powerful.
